findings.label: No answer reveal without a daily channel
findings.location: bot.py hangman_daily / hangman_start_cmd; README.md Daily AREDL Hangman section
findings.detail: With no loss state, an unsolved puzzle's answer is only shown publicly by hangman_daily, which posts only to daily_channel_ids(). Guilds that play via /hangman start without a daily channel never see the answer (only privately via /hangman giveup), contradicting the README's 'the next day's post reveals yesterday's level either way'.
findings.action: Show data['previous'] in the first /hangman start board of the new day, or narrow the README wording to the daily channel.
